summary: Implement a gitignore(5) matcher that agrees with git for a single root .gitignore.
what_tests_check: Anchoring rules (leading/middle slash vs basename match), dir-only patterns, * vs ** (leading, trailing, middle, non-boundary), negation with last-match-wins, no re-inclusion inside an excluded parent directory, comments/escapes (\#, \!, \*), trailing-space trimming, ? and bracket classes; all expectations verified against real git.
